questions.question_text:
RECALL AND CONNECT 2:
a) What are the economic benefits of living near a volcano?
b) Name three scales that are used to measure earthquakes.
c) What is a lahar?
d) Draw a labelled diagram to show the main features of a cinder cone volcano.

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1 and AO2: Answer cross-topic questions on tectonic hazards.
keywords_required: a) Fertile volcanic soils (good for agriculture), geothermal energy, tourism.
b) Richter scale, Mercalli scale, Moment Magnitude scale.
c) A destructive mudflow on the slopes of a volcano.
d) Diagram showing steep conical hill, bowl-shaped crater at the summit, built from volcanic ash/cinders.

questions.question_text:
Copy and complete Tables 2.1 and 2.2.
Hard engineering: Sea wall, Groynes.
Soft engineering: Beach nourishment, Managed retreat.
(For each, provide: Description, Advantage, Disadvantage, Level of sustainability).

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1 and AO2: Evaluate coastal management strategies.
keywords_required: Sea wall: Concrete wall; prevents erosion and flooding; expensive and ugly; low sustainability.
Groynes: Wooden/stone fences built at right angles to the coast; traps sand to build beach; starves beaches down-drift of sand; moderate/low sustainability.
Beach nourishment: Adding sand to a beach; looks natural and cheap; needs constant replacing; moderate sustainability.
Managed retreat: Allowing the sea to flood low-value land; creates salt marshes and is cheap; loss of land/farmland; high sustainability.

questions.question_text: What are some threats to mangroves?

keywords_required: Deforestation for timber and fuel.
Clearance for aquaculture (e.g. shrimp farming).
Coastal development and pollution.
Climate change and sea level rise.

questions.question_text: Describe three impacts of a tropical storm.

keywords_required: Strong winds destroying buildings/infrastructure.
Storm surges causing severe coastal flooding.
Heavy rainfall leading to inland flooding and landslides.
Loss of life, destruction of crops.

questions.question_text: Study Figure 2.3. Describe the distribution of coral reefs.

marking_scheme.rubric: AO3: Describe the pattern from the map.
keywords_required: Mainly found between the Tropics (Cancer and Capricorn) / near the Equator.
Found in shallow, warm waters.
Concentrations in South East Asia, the Caribbean, and off the east coast of Australia.

questions.question_text: Describe two opportunities of living near the coast.

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1 and AO2: Give two opportunities and describe them.
keywords_required: Fishing (provides food and income).
Tourism (beautiful beaches attract visitors, creating jobs).
Ports/shipping (enables international trade).
Renewable energy (offshore wind farms, tidal energy).

questions.question_text: Using an example you have studied, describe the impacts of a tropical storm.

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1 and AO2: Case study detailing impacts.
keywords_required: Must name a specific tropical storm (e.g. Typhoon Haiyan, Hurricane Katrina).
Detail primary impacts (e.g. winds destroyed X% of buildings, storm surge flooded Y city).
Detail secondary impacts (e.g. disease outbreaks due to contaminated water, economic losses, looting).
